about: Hand labels for entity linking. `groups` are mentions judged to be the same subject; `unsure` mentions are left out of scoring entirely, because a label nobody can defend grades the labeller rather than the linker. Every other mention is its own entity. Labelled from the stored descriptions alone, by reading them -- not from the video -- and after one look at test1's outputs, so test1 is the tuning set and test2 the check. `different` names unsure mentions that are nonetheless clearly NOT a given group -- a dark puffy coat is not the woman in the gray top -- so linking them counts as wrong; added after the first real run merged exactly those, which the unsure exclusion had hidden.
